project_info.design_philosophy: Confident, direct, results-oriented, zero jargon. High contrast black/white structure with electric orange accents to drive conversion. Simplify dense text into bento grids, stats, and clear visual hierarchy.

typography.rules: Headings (H1/H2) must be font-weight: 900 with letter-spacing: -0.02em. Body text must be font-weight: 400 with line-height: 1.6.

global_layout.header: Sticky positioned (z-index: 50), background var(--color-bg) with 90% opacity and backdrop-filter: blur(10px). Contains Logo, Nav Links (Home, Services, Portfolio, About, Resources, Contact), Dark Mode Toggle Button, and CTA 'Free Consultation'.
global_layout.footer: Background var(--color-surface). 4 columns: Company Info, Quick Links, Services, Contact/Socials. Bottom bar with copyright.

illustrations_and_media.rules: Strictly NO stock photography. Use inline SVGs or CSS-based abstract compositions. Focus on crisp geometric lines, isometric technical grids, and soft orange/black mesh gradients for backgrounds. Emphasize negative space.

buttons.primary: Background: var(--color-primary), Text: White, Padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-8), Radius: var(--radius-sm), Hover: Transform translateY(-2px), Box-shadow.
buttons.secondary: Background: Transparent, Border: 2px solid var(--color-text-main), Text: var(--color-text-main), Hover: Background var(--color-text-main), Text var(--color-bg).

cards.service_card: Background: var(--color-surface), Padding: var(--space-8), Border: 1px solid var(--color-border). Hover effect: Border color transitions to var(--color-primary), icon scales up slightly.

forms.inputs: Background: Transparent, Border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border) (No side/top borders for modern feel), Padding: var(--space-4) 0. Focus: Border-bottom var(--color-primary), Outline: none. Labels float or sit above input.
forms.behavior: Static HTML UI, no backend wiring required.

accordion.faq: Border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border), Padding: var(--space-4) 0. Icon: '+' rotates 45deg to 'x' on open.

micro_interactions.scroll_reveals: Use Vanilla JS IntersectionObserver. Elements start with opacity: 0, transform: translateY(20px). On intersection, transition to opacity: 1, transform: translateY(0) over 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Stagger children delays by 100ms.
micro_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must transition smoothly (transition: all 0.2s ease). Icons in service cards translate right by 4px on hover.
micro_interactions.dark_mode_toggle: Vanilla JS appending 'dark-theme' class to body, save preference in localStorage.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, toggles, accordions) MUST possess a 'data-testid' attribute formatted in kebab-case representing their role. Example: data-testid='home-primary-cta'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure var(--color-primary) #e57119 has sufficient contrast against backgrounds. On white, it is 3:1 (large text) but for small text use a darker shade or bold weight. All text must pass WCAG AA.
accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: All focusable elements must have a visible focus outline: outline: 2px dashed var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 4px;
